title: Coders Módulo 4 — Observabilidade da API
description: Tráfego, erros, latência, endpoints, auth, logs, traces, alertas e saúde da telemetria.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="coders-modulo-4-api"} |= "HTTP request completed" | statusCode=~"5.." [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="coders-modulo-4-api"} |= "HTTP request completed" [$__range]))

panels.description: 1 = a API gerou spans nos últimos 5 min; 0 = sem tráfego/telemetria.

panels.title: Latência da API: p50 / p95 / p99

targets.expr: sum by (statusCode, path) (count_over_time({service_name="coders-modulo-4-api"} |= "HTTP request completed" | statusCode=~"[45].." [$__auto]))

panels.title: Endpoints: o que funciona e o que não

targets.expr: sum by (method, path, statusCode) (count_over_time({service_name="coders-modulo-4-api"} |= "HTTP request completed" | statusCode!="" [$__range]))
topk(10, quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="coders-modulo-4-api"} |= "HTTP request completed" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]) by (path))
